lines.t:
CHAPTER 9
Across the Multiverse
The ring opens doors that were never meant to open. Beyond each door, a different universe.
A bright world of heroes, where a bored bald man ends battles with a single punch.
A city of lightning, where the fastest runner alive waits at the finish line.
A dimension of folding libraries, ruled by a sorcerer in a red cloak.
And a grey realm of silent soldiers, waiting for a king.
Every world has someone who can teach me. I'll learn from all of them.
TRAINING: Open the Map → Multiverse. Visit each world, train with its mentor, and pass its trial. After unlocking ARISE, defeat eligible enemies and extract their shadows.

scenes.title: Ten Years

lines.t: Peter does not go home.
He trains. A hundred push-ups, a hundred sit-ups, a hundred squats, ten kilometres — every day, in every world.
He races lightning until he is lightning. He folds space until distance means nothing.
He stands before an army of the fallen and speaks a single word.
ARISE.
He learns the colours of every aura — green will, blue hope, violet love, golden courage, crimson rage, orange desire, indigo compassion — and the white light that holds them all.

lines.why: ten years of missions across the multiverse

lines.t: TEN YEARS LATER
Nexa. Ten years later.
The four crews are pro hero agencies now — richer, stronger, more influential than ever. Bruce Kaizer is the No. 4 hero on the planet.
Peter Parker? The powerless kid? He ran away. Weak people always do.
Most of Nexa has forgotten him. But not everyone.
Every evening, Elena Parker still sets an extra plate on the table.
And John Reyes, now a hero himself, still checks every missing-person report that comes in.
Somewhere far away, a man of twenty-six looks at an old family photo.
Ten years. It's time to go home.

scenes.hint: Complete 'Across the Multiverse': pass the four trials and build a Shadow Army of 3.
